mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fees (student_id, class_id, billing_month, fee_amount, discount_amount, due_date, status_code, description) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{classId}, #{billingMonth}, #{feeAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{dueDate}, #{statusCode}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT fee_id, student_id, class_id, billing_month, fee_amount, discount_amount, due_date, status_code, description, created_at FROM fees WHERE fee_id = #{feeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE fees SET fee_amount = #{feeAmount}, discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, due_date = #{dueDate}, description = #{description}, status_code = #{statusCode} WHERE fee_id = #{feeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee_payments (fee_id, paid_amount, paid_at, payment_method, cancel_yn) VALUES (#{feeId}, #{paidAmount}, #{paidAt}, #{paymentMethod}, 'N')
mapper.select: SELECT payment_id, fee_id, paid_amount, paid_at, payment_method, receipt_no, cancel_yn, created_at FROM fee_payments WHERE payment_id = #{paymentId}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0) FROM fee_payments WHERE fee_id = #{feeId} AND cancel_yn = 'N'
